chunks: Except those who closely follow (the Book of God),

key_terms.الْمُصَلِّينَ: Those who pray / Those who follow closely

ai.seo_question: Who is excepted from the general rule in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this fragmentary phrase from Surah Al-Ma'arij is often interpreted as an exception for the *Salihin* (the righteous) who maintain consistent prayer (*Salah*) and spiritual vigilance. It highlights the distinction between the general masses and those who achieve salvation through disciplined worship and adherence to divine commandments, a concept central to Shia theological discussions on *Tawhid* and *Adl*. This exception underscores the practical necessity of ritual prayer as a means of elevating the soul above worldly distractions.
